learning_outcomes.text: Diagnosis of physical fitness and physical development.
He knows how to work on his comprehensive, harmonious physical development
Has the knowledge to actively participate in physical culture of a recreational, sporting or tourist nature throughout his or her life
Knows the methods, means and forms of work on multiplying one's own health and physical fitness
Knows how to work on his comprehensive, harmonious physical development
Has the skills to participate actively in physical culture of a recreational, sporting or tourist nature throughout his/her life

syllabus_topics: Teaching basic forms of physical activity.
Health effects of sports in college and in the future.
Safe physical activity and personal hygiene

assessment_methods.method: Average grade point from the fitness test of prof. Pilicz
Attendance and active participation in the classes

assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes. The final grade is based on the average grade point from the fitness test of prof. Pilicz, attendance and active participation in the classes.
